messages.subject: crosstype: which option to use
parts:
HI , 

I have using R/qtl for qtl mapping from BXD mouse genetic reference population . The strains are not F2 but pure inbred lines (+20 generations).
I would like to know for read.cross , which "crosstype" I should use. f2 or risib ?
I am getting slightly difference results (in terms of LOD score, p-value and qtl location) from both.
Thanks
